title: Fail open for progress, closed for credit
statement: When lesson machinery fails, let the learner carry on rather than trap them, but credit only what they did, by a typed answer or fallback check, never on trust.
detail: The reference player spec that a Grade 5 reading lesson copied makes every failure release the learner: a render that throws, a missing clip, a missing image or a downed scorer must never wall the child in. The same spec accepts a spoken turn on trust when no microphone or scorer is available. An audit of the build cites a course rule against honour-system theatre, and the build instead offers the same step with a typed answer box when no speech recogniser is available and falls back silently to a local judge when the remote scorer fails. An item released after repeated wrong answers is marked as practised with help, never tallied as solo.
against: The reference spec credits on trust: "No mic/STT available → honour-system accept" (`grade3-reading/artifacts/u4l2-build/BEAT-SPEC.md`, line 125) and "Degrade-open: scorer down → honour-system accept." (the same file, line 410). The fallback check is weaker than the remote one: a gate's floor "can be bridged by an answer that names one source plus the other side's content word" (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-deploy/BUILD-NOTES.md`, lines 788-789).

evidence.quote: a render that throws, a missing clip, a 404'd image or a downed scorer must never wall the child in — release the beat, silent-skip the clip, hide the figure, thank the speaker. A child is never left without the question or the way out.
otherwise the SAME beat with a clearly labeled type-your-answer input. Talk-or-write both open on every free response.
Any failure (timeout 60 s, non-200, bad shape, static serving) degrades SILENTLY to the local judge, label unchanged.
marks the item "practiced with help" (never tallied as solo)
